projects.title: Obsidian Optics
projects.description: A high-performance real-time edge computer vision pipeline using YOLOv8 and PyTorch for multi-object tracking and zone analytics.
projects.longDescription: Obsidian Optics is a deep learning computer vision system designed for intelligent video analytics. It leverages custom-trained YOLOv8 weights optimized for edge devices (Jetson Nano/Raspberry Pi) and provides multi-object tracking (DeepSORT) with real-time speed. Built with a full dashboard, it tracks entry-exit counts, custom bounding zones, and thermal density estimation inside recorded streams, displaying analytical heatmaps using D3.js and WebSockets.

projects.title: Daily Decipher
projects.description: An automated AI newsletter summarization engine that aggregates technical publications and outputs high-signal digests.
projects.longDescription: Daily Decipher is a personal aggregator and summarizer. It periodically crawls top-tier machine learning publications (arXiv, Hugging Face Daily, TechCrunch) and stock market blogs. Using Gemini 1.5/3.5 models via a custom multi-agent structure, it parses dense technical texts, summarizes them into structured Markdown, extracts core sentiments, and automatically distributes them to a Telegram group and email subscribers via Mailgun.

projects.title: BullRun Analytics
projects.description: Financial sentiment analyzer correlating global financial news and Reddit trends with technical market indicators.
projects.longDescription: BullRun Analytics represents my stock market learning journey. It is a full-stack engine that tracks tickers, performs text sentiment classification using FinBERT, and overlays these sentiment indexes on stock charts. Users can visualize correlation peaks between social media hype (Reddit /r/wallstreetbets) and actual volume breakouts, utilizing a React financial charting interface.

projects.title: Cognitive Canvas
projects.description: A media resource hub that translates conceptual sketches and raw assets into high-CTR graphic templates.
projects.longDescription: Cognitive Canvas merges my skill as a Freelance Thumbnail Designer with software. It uses AI diffusion models and canvas-based layering (React Konva) to let creators draft design assets rapidly. Users can upload rough layouts, write text prompts, and watch the system generate aesthetic, high-contrast, clickable thumbnail compositions ready for export in 4K resolution.

blogs.title: The Architecture of Obsidian Optics: Real-time YOLOv8 Deployments
blogs.excerpt: How to deploy custom YOLOv8 object tracking models to edge microcontrollers with minimal latency and high frame rates.
blogs.content:
### The Computer Vision Challenge

When building Obsidian Optics, my goal was clear: track objects in real-time on standard, low-powered computational chips. Standard YOLO pipelines are computationally intensive, causing frame rate drops on non-GPU instances. 

#### Optimizations Applied:
1. **FP16 Quantization**: Reduced model parameters from 32-bit floats to 16-bit half-precision floats, boosting inference speed by ~40% with a negligible <0.8% drop in mean Average Precision (mAP).
2. **Region-of-Interest (ROI) Masking**: Instead of feeding the whole 1080p frame into the CNN, the pipeline dynamically clips regions where motion is detected, running CNN inference only on localized boxes.
3. **DeepSORT Association**: Avoided continuous model re-evaluation by using Kalman Filters for frame-to-frame tracking, saving precious CPU clock cycles.

The resulting engine maintains **30+ FPS** even when tracking multiple dynamic actors inside restricted perimeter zones!

blogs.title: Deciphering Market Sentiment: Building a News Sentiment Engine
blogs.excerpt: Exploring how standard NLP models like FinBERT can predict asset movement trends when combined with real-time stock social metrics.
blogs.content:
### The Intersection of Sentiment and Assets

Can words predict trends? In stock markets, public fear and enthusiasm play a huge role in price discovery. For BullRun Analytics, I set out to construct a pipeline that quantifies the "mood" of Wall Street.

#### The Core Technical Pipeline:
- **Scraper**: A lightweight Node.js cron utility fetches market headlines from Yahoo Finance and feeds from trading communities.
- **FinBERT Pipeline**: While generic NLP models classify financial words like "debt" or "bear" as neutral/negative, FinBERT is pre-trained on financial context, realizing that "bearish consolidation" denotes a highly structured market state.
- **Sentiment Index Calculation**: I calculate a rolling 6-hour average sentiment score:
  $$\text{Sentiment Index} = \frac{\text{Positive} - \text{Negative}}{\text{Total Headlines} + 1}$$
- **Correlation Overlay**: Integrating this index on top of real charts revealed that rapid sentiment drops precede actual volume breakdowns by approximately 35 minutes on mid-cap tech tickers.

Building this dashboard opened my eyes to how deeply mathematical models can illuminate human irrationality in high-velocity trading.

blogs.title: 3rd Semester CS Survival Guide: Balancing DSA, ML, and Web Dev
blogs.excerpt: An honest look at how I manage college lectures, competitive coding streaks, deep learning studies, and client freelancing.
blogs.content:
### The College Conundrum

Third semester in Computer Science is notoriously intense. You are introduced to core concepts like Object Oriented Programming, Database Systems, and Discrete Math, while simultaneously feeling the heat of competitive coding and the rush of AI developments.

#### My 3-Bucket System:
- **Bucket A (The GPA Guard)**: Dedicate 2 hours of focused studying to college subjects every evening. This keeps the CGPA safe at **9.06** and prevents exam stress.
- **Bucket B (The Craft Core)**: Maintain the LeetCode streak (now at 142 days) by solving at least 1-2 medium problems first thing in the morning.
- **Bucket C (The Creative Income)**: Dedicate weekends to client freelance work and building side projects like Daily Decipher.

*Advice to peers*: Do not try to master everything in one day. Consistent, incremental gains are infinitely more powerful than random weekend marathons.
